# MauiDev

Developer productivity toolkit for .NET MAUI: `maui-dev` doctor / analyze / resources / permissions / platform / signing / workload / version / dependencies / icons / publish / migrate / telemetry / benchmark / clean / package, plus a VS Code / Cursor extension.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiDev
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.MauiDev.Cli
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0 (dotnet tool). The VS Code extension requires VS Code / Cursor 1.90+.

## Installation

dotnet tool install -g Plugin.Maui.MauiDev.Cli --source https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json

Then: `maui-dev doctor`. Also `permissions`, `platform`, `publish --validate`, `migrate`, `telemetry`, `benchmark`. Do not `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.MauiDev.Cli` into an app.

Version: 1.2.2. Interactive nuget.org update prompt every 4 hours (`[y/N]`, default no). Skip: `--no-update-check`, `NUVYNTRA_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1`, `--ci`, JSON/SARIF, non-TTY. `--no-update-check` is 1.2.2+; 1.2.1 rejects it. Nuvyn calls `maui-dev doctor --path <app>` without that flag. Cache: `~/.nuvyntra/cli-updates.json`. The CLI does not phone home.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I diagnose MAUI SDK / workload / Android SDK / JDK / Xcode issues?
- Why is my MAUI project misconfigured (UseMaui, duplicate splash, unused permissions)?
- MAUI resource duplicates or missing MauiImage files
- CI-friendly MAUI doctor JSON
- Validate NuGet pack metadata before CI

## Do not use when

- You need runtime leak detection → Plugin.Maui.LeakAnalyser
- You need startup traces → Plugin.Maui.Performance / maui-perf
- You need crash / ANR reporting → Plugin.Maui.Diagnostics
- You need device health (battery, thermal) → Plugin.Maui.AppHealth
- The .NET MAUI framework API already solves the request
